_comment: SHA-256 manifest of the seed pattern.html blobs (origin §6.4 security note). The pattern blobs are trusted-by-assumption inputs to the substitution path; this manifest makes any modification to a blob visible in a PR. pattern-manifest.test.ts asserts the on-disk blobs hash to these values, and U9/U11's pipeline re-runs the integrity scan + this check. Regenerate intentionally via the regen path in pattern-manifest.ts when a pattern is deliberately edited.
